subject: ext-f
title: EXT.F.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 157 (UPB(II)-19). EXT-F (extended functionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and TRS (transition). From MT-INFO: POL-SIGN (political significance) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PART: TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment). From TH-AF-ALGN: AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree). From VT-DY: OP-SD (option spread). From TRS: INFO-DY.
